published_ranges._notes: Density, temps, Vicat from official OVERTURE TURBO PLA TDS EN V5.1 (Jul/Aug 2024); fan 'Turned on'; melt index 26.0 g/10min @220C/2.16kg. TDS gives no diameter, tolerance, drying, HDT or max volumetric speed; diameter 1.75 from official product title. COLORS: the main overture3d.com/products/turbo-pla URL now redirects to a collection page and the US site lists only 'Overture High Speed PLA' (likely the renamed line - not confirmed). The only Turbo PLA colour read on an official page is 'Plaster White' (overture3d.com/hy regional page). OVERTURE 3D's Amazon listing B07PGY2JP1 (item highlight 'Rapid PLA', now titled 'OVERTURE High Speed PLA') offers many colours (Black, White, Cold White, Red, Fresh Red, Orange, Yellow, Light Blue, Blue, Green, Purple, Pink, Brown, Chocolate, Space Gray, Light Gray, Cement Gray, Gray Blue, Olive Green, Highlight Yellow, Lemon Yellow, Magenta, Mint Green, Beige Skin, Avocado, Royal Gold, Silk Gold, Sparkle Black, Sparkle Purple, Metallic Gray, Rainbow, Northern Lights, Rocket Pop, Tequila Sunrise, Aurora Berry) but it is not explicitly labelled Turbo PLA, so those were not put in colors. bambu_parent 'Overture PLA' is the brand's Bambu Studio system preset per run guidance; not separately confirmed for Turbo PLA. Earlier entry: TDS v5.1 (Jul 2024): high-speed PLA; melt index 26.0 g/10min (220C 2.16kg); cooling fan on; based on 0.4 mm nozzle. Discontinued on overture3d.com: overture3d.com/products/turbo-pla now redirects to the homepage (checked 2026-11-01). Diameter not printed in the TDS, so filament_diameter left out. Amazon/reseller listings describe a cardboard spool: wrap edges before AMS use. Colours not recorded.
